title: turfc --diagnostics=json, one diagnostic
description: Each line turfc writes to stderr under --diagnostics=json is one object of this shape. Schema version 1.1: a minor version adds fields, a major version changes or removes one. Lines and columns are 1-based; columns count bytes; a span's end is exclusive.

code.description: Every error has one; a warning without a registry row has null.

title.description: The heading line of the text form, e.g. "Nothing to infer!".

span.description: null for a diagnostic about a whole file.

label.description: Since 1.1. What the underline at `span` says, e.g. "this is an `int`"; null when `span` is. The entries of `related` are the secondary spans, each labelled by its `message`.

fix.description: The compiler's checked fix (the text form's Fix: line), or null.

tier.description: Since 1.2. The Fix Score's tier (SL-1): proven, or plausible when a flag is raised. A fix that is not valid is never reported.

flags.description: Since 1.2. Why a plausible fix needs a look, one plain sentence each ("it removes a call"); empty for a proven fix.

denied.description: A warning whose lint level is deny; its severity is error.
